Title: Vikram and the Family

Cast

1. Vikram - 30 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Ajay - 64 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd
2. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The bazaar - Day

[Vikram stands in the bazaar. Ajay stands near him.]

Vikram: "What lovely weather!"

[Vikram haggles with the shopkeeper.]

Vikram: "Let's see."

[Vikram pays the fruit seller.]

Ajay: "And then?"

[Vikram walks through the crowded bazaar.]

Vikram: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The ghat - Day

[Vikram stands on the ghat. Ajay stands near him.]

Ajay: "What a nice place."

[Vikram lays a garland on the photo of his late father.]

Vikram: "Well done!"

[Vikram stands in silence with his head bowed.]

Vikram: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
